section banner: LOAD AND PREPARE DATA

spans.operation: load the raw soccer referee/player dataset from CSV as the full analysis scope

spans.note: print raw dataset shape and dyad count

spans.operation: average the two independent raters' scores into a single continuous skin-tone measure
dichotomize continuous skin tone at the 0.50 midpoint into dark/light categories, excluding exactly-neutral or missing ratings
collapse the red card count into a binary any-red-card outcome using a >0 threshold

spans.note: print skin tone categorization counts
section banner: CREATE ANALYTICAL SAMPLE

spans.operation: restrict the analytic sample to dyads with a non-missing, non-neutral skin tone category
drop dyads with missing height, weight, position, or league covariates

spans.note: print sample size after covariate completeness filter
section banner: CREATE MODEL MATRIX

spans.operation: build the model design matrix: one-hot encode position and league (dropping a reference level) and choose the full covariate/adjustment set alongside darkSkin as predictors of any red card
drop remaining rows with any missing predictor value and designate player identity as the clustering unit for later SE estimation

spans.note: print final analytical sample summary counts
section banner: UNADJUSTED ANALYSIS

spans.operation: compute the unadjusted risk difference as the raw difference in red-card rates between dark- and light-skin groups

spans.note: print unadjusted rates and risk difference
section banner: ADJUSTED ANALYSIS: LOGISTIC REGRESSION

spans.operation: fit a logistic regression of any red card on skin tone and covariates with cluster-robust standard errors grouped by player

spans.note: print predictor count and events-per-predictor before fitting
print model convergence status

spans.operation: treat the darkSkin coefficient from the fitted model as the focal adjusted effect to report

spans.note: section banner: SECONDARY ESTIMAND: ADJUSTED ODDS RATIO

spans.operation: exponentiate the darkSkin coefficient and its CI to report an adjusted odds ratio as a secondary effect measure

spans.note: print odds ratio, coefficient, SE, p-value
section banner: PRIMARY ESTIMAND: ADJUSTED RISK DIFFERENCE

spans.operation: estimate an adjusted, covariate-standardized risk difference via g-computation by scoring every observation under counterfactual darkSkin=1 vs darkSkin=0 and averaging
derive the risk difference's standard error via the delta method and construct a 95%-level Wald confidence interval and two-sided z-test p-value

spans.note: print adjusted risk difference results
section banner: CONCLUSION
print conclusion section header

spans.operation: declare the hypothesis supported or not based on whether the risk-difference CI excludes zero and p<=0.05
